probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening does not extend through the entire thickness of the packaging structure at the chip mounting surface__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and does not extend to a sidewall of the opening__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and is not bonded to a bottom surface of the opening__.

4. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and into an underlying core layer__.

6. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

7. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid.

9. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __and is not a lid__.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure __and the stiffening microstructure is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material__.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure __with a depth that does not extend through the entire thickness of the packaging structure at the chip mounting surface__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening __and is not bonded to both the bottom surface and the sidewall simultaneously__.

16. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and into an underlying core layer__.

18. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring or a lid __and the stiffening microstructure is not a solid structure extending across the entire opening__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with ground reference plane layer __and is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material__.
